svg.title: Neural-network to physical analog ReRAM mapping
svg.desc: A 2–3–2 illustrative network maps to differential ReRAM matrices of 2 by 3 and 3 by 2, with continuous analog hidden-layer signals and three abstract Neuron Circuit modules. The schematic output decision is labeled Softmax / Argmax, without claiming a software or analog-circuit implementation. Enlarged first-stage detail shows two 2 by 3 conductance banks, inverted current-to-voltage converters, B minus minus B plus subtraction, activation and follower. Paired-column placement is conceptual, not a fabricated layout.

g.text: Neural network → Fully Analog ReRAM Inference Accelerator
Weights become conductances; neuron signals stay in the analog domain.
Illustrative scale; not the MNIST topology.
Hidden neurons: I–V → subtract → activate → drive
No ADC/DAC blocks between modeled layers; boundary I/O abstracted.
Physical signal path · one selected hidden neuron j
Neuron Circuit: current → voltage → activation → drive
Resistive bridges connect rows to columns.
Wire arches denote crossings without electrical junctions.
Finite gains and circuit offsets enter the software model.
Current conversion precedes subtraction; hidden layers retain AF + VF.
Conceptual mapping · not to scale · two banks shown; exact spatial organization is illustrative
Reference model: Scophield/HCST. Circuit symbols are functional; no fabricated-die, transistor-validation or measured-PPA claim.
Output decision is schematic, without an implementation claim.
